body:
Source: GitHub issues #759 and #760 (P1-high, false-green). Re-verified on main @ 920973bb.
(a) #759: packages/runner/lib/assertions.mjs PHASE_REQUIREMENTS.p4 = ['p4-build','rails-check','flail-check']; only rails-check is content-verified (p4IntegrityErrors re-hashes railFiles). p4-build and flail-check are bare presence, and requiresRevision is true only for p5/p6. Repro: record p4-build/flail-check/rails-check for T1, 'adlc run p4 --ticket T1' -> exit 0; rewrite a source file, re-record ONLY rails-check -> still exit 0.
(b) #760: PHASE_REQUIREMENTS.p2 = ['coldstart','merge-forecast']; requiresTicket omits p2 and coldstartIntegrityErrors runs only for phase p0 with a ticket, so matchesTicket(entry, undefined) accepts any coldstart and any merge-forecast anywhere. Repro: a coldstart with 3 unresolved gaps for T1 plus a merge-forecast for T9 -> 'adlc run p0 --ticket T1' exit 2, 'adlc run p2' exit 0.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package packages/runner (lib/assertions.mjs; bin; cli consumes it via packages/cli/lib/dispatch.mjs). Tests: npm test -w packages/runner. Existing tests runner.test.mjs, p0-p1-gates.test.mjs, cli-exit-codes.test.mjs, own-chain-chronology.test.mjs pin other behaviour (read before changing; any that pin the bug may be rewritten — say so in the PR body). Grep consumers first: grep -rln "adlc run p2\|adlc run p4\|PHASE_REQUIREMENTS\|requiresTicket" packages plugins scripts docs — autopilot and plugins may invoke 'run p2' without a ticket; list them and decide per NORMATIVE 2.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. p4: the p4-build and flail-check markers must carry a revision (or changed-file hashes, as 'rails-check' does via entry.files) and p4 evidence is rejected when the recorded revision/hashes no longer match the current worktree, with the same reject message style p4IntegrityErrors uses today. ONE exported validator used by the run path; exit 2 on rejection. A p4 record that is fresh must still pass.
2. p2: require a ticket (add to requiresTicket) and apply coldstartIntegrityErrors to its coldstart requirement so the same record cannot be contradictory at p0 and sufficient at p2; the merge-forecast must match the ticket. If a real caller needs the ticket-less sweep, keep it ONLY if the consumer grep proves one exists, document it in the README phase table, and still validate each coldstart entry it counts; otherwise the missing-ticket case is an operational error with the existing message wording for other ticketed phases.
3. p0, p1, p3, p5, p6, p7 behaviour unchanged.
4. Documentation: update packages/runner/README.md and make the SAME edit by hand in apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/runner.mdx (hand-maintained mirror — never regenerate).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 Stale p4-build/flail-check (tree edited after record) -> exit 2 naming the stale marker; fresh -> exit 0. verify: `node --test packages/runner/test/p2-p4-evidence-binding.test.mjs`
- AC2 p2 with a coldstart that p0 rejects -> exit 2; a merge-forecast for another ticket does not satisfy p2. verify: `node --test packages/runner/test/p2-p4-evidence-binding.test.mjs`
- AC3 p2 without a ticket behaves per NORMATIVE 2 (asserted in the direction chosen: fail-closed). verify: `node --test packages/runner/test/p2-p4-evidence-binding.test.mjs`
- AC4 Drive the real bin in at least one test (not only mocked records). verify: `node --test packages/runner/test/p2-p4-evidence-binding.test.mjs`
- AC5 Existing suite and consumers green. verify: `npm test -w packages/runner` plus consumer tests named in the lane.
- AC6 Docs updated in both places. verify: grep for the new statement in README and mdx.
- AC7 Mutation gate green. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also --max 80 locally).

OUT OF SCOPE: other runner issues (#846 docs, #761); changing p5/p6 revision logic.
title: runner: p4 evidence is bound to the current tree and p2 requires a ticket with the same coldstart integrity as p0
